name: Happy Hooves Equine Ltd - Equine Assisted Therapy

profile.name: Happy Hooves Equine Ltd - Equine Assisted Therapy
profile.description:
Welcome to Happy Hooves Equine Ltd!

We provide equine-assisted learning, therapeutic visits, and animal-assisted activities for children, young people, adults, schools, care homes, hospitals, and community groups.

Our miniature horses help create meaningful experiences that promote confidence, emotional wellbeing, communication, social skills, and connection. Through the unique bond between humans and horses, we support individuals of all ages and abilities, including those with additional needs such as autism, anxiety, and SEN.

On this channel, you’ll find behind-the-scenes moments from our herd, therapy and educational visits, horse care tips, success stories, special events, and a glimpse into the positive impact horses can have on people’s lives.

Whether you’re a horse lover, parent, educator, care provider, or simply interested in the power of animal-assisted activities, we invite you to follow our journey.

Don’t forget to subscribe and join the Happy Hooves family! ✨

cautions: 简介自称的服务范围与资质未经核实，不能据此确认实际服务能力或疗效。
